title: Easy Tagg v2.9.10.94 available
message: Player At-Bats now uses a stable two-level view: select a player, then scroll through that player's complete AB history in a dedicated screen.
releaseNotes: Replaces nested accordion scrolling with a player list and a separate player detail view. The detail screen has one dedicated scroll area, a BACK button, and preserves manual REFRESH plus the existing History analysis logic.
